test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abundant
solution:
The correct answer is **Scarce.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym** refers to **words opposite in meaning.**
 
• **“Abundant”** means **plenty in number**.
 
• Therefore, "**scarce"** would be the **perfect antonym** for it **as it stands for lack.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **“Surplus”** refers to “**excess of something that is not needed**.”
 
• **“Brilliant”** means “**intelligent**”.
 
• **“Rich”** means “**wealthy”**.
